desc: Write a function to read input and process T test cases.
For each test case, read N, K and the cake attributes.
Calculate the sum of attributes for each cake.
Sort the cakes by this sum in descending order.
Pair the $i$-th selected cake with the $(2K-1-i)$-th selected cake for $i$ from 0 to K-1.
Calculate the price of each pair as $\max(X_a+X_b, Y_a+Y_b, Z_a+Z_b)$.
Sum the prices and print the result.
Ensure the solution handles multiple test cases efficiently.
